The CSR Model

Clarity.
Safety.
Repair.

A framework for thinking about misunderstanding, conversational safety, and what comes after disconnection.

Explore the ideas

Three connected ideas

A little more understanding.
A different conversation.

01

Clarity

Make meaning easier to understand.

What am I trying to communicate? What has the other person understood? Making room for these questions can help reveal a misunderstanding.

02

Safety

Notice how the conversation feels.

Harshness and disconnection can change an exchange. Pausing to recognize what is happening creates space to consider how to continue.

03

Repair

Return to what happened.

After hurt or misunderstanding, acknowledge the impact and consider what needs attention before moving forward.
